Summary
On has partnered with global music artist Burna Boy to debut their first collaborative footwear capsuleThe delivery introduces an all-red Cloudmonster and an all-white ROGER Clubhouse detailed with shaggy laces and red heel stitchingBoth silhouettes are available now through On starting at $
